name: 15 Hudson Yards

viewpoint.note: Tenth Avenue at West 30th Street, about 250 m east of the tower, looking west at the curved shaft of 15 Hudson Yards
viewpoint.source: moved onto road-network node 21145 ('10 AVE & W 30 ST'; nodes.parquet names it '10 AVE & HIGH LINE' with W 30 ST in its names list; NYC_TM (-4305.46, 5783.25)), the intersection this note names, on the J75 rule that the city's own road network is the independent anchor; the coordinate this replaces (40.75311, -74.000277) stood 130.2 m from that node inside the Eastern Rail Yard, on a heightmap sample of -0.90 m (the 2013 yard floor under Tenth Avenue, docs/DEVIATIONS.md J85), so the camera stood 9 m below the street and rendered half soffit; from the node the subject is 245.7 m away, which agrees with the note's 'about 250 m'
viewpoint.azimuth_source: the bearing from the corrected viewpoint to the subject coordinate (40.7535, -74.0032 = NYC_TM (-4492.63, 5942.46)); the 280.0 deg it replaces pointed at the subject from the replaced coordinate to within 0.1 deg, which is how the two were found to share one error (J75, J85)
